title: test_export_model_precommit fails accuracy validation for opt_gptq katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq
signature: accuracy validation failed assertionerror in test export model precommit opt gptq katuni4ka|Code Issue
failed_jobs: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
root_cause: The test_export_model_precommit test for opt_gptq (katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq) failed with an accuracy validation mismatch. The maximum difference between framework (PyTorch) and OpenVINO inference outputs was ~0.069, exceeding the allowed tolerance. This indicates a deterministic numerical mismatch in the conversion/export path for OPT-GPTQ 4-bit quantized model export mode, likely introduced by a code change in PR #37029.
